args.query: What does the Binance 24hr ticker endpoint return?

data.query: What does the Binance 24hr ticker endpoint return?

chunks.title: Binance spot market data endpoints
chunks.text: Binance publishes read-only market data endpoints that need no API key. The 24-hour ticker endpoint (/api/v3/ticker/24hr) returns the last price, the price change and percent change over a rolling 24-hour window, the 24-hour high and low, base asset volume and quote asset volume. The klines endpoint (/api/v3/klines) returns candlesticks for a symbol and interval, each with open time, open, high, low, close, volume, close time and quote asset volume. The depth endpoint (/api/v3/depth) returns current bids and asks at each price level. The exchange information endpoint (/api/v3/exchangeInfo) lists every trading pair and its status.
